description: Opaleye: stamps lab.target_id and lab.rebuild_generation from the agent registry, and guarantees event.ingested. Final pipeline of every evidence data stream (set by the @custom component templates). The agents map is appended to by scripts/fleetctl.py register-agent and never pruned, so late events of an old generation keep their generation.

script.source: def a = ctx.agent; if (a == null || a.id == null) { return; } def m = params.agents.get(a.id); if (m == null) { return; } if (ctx.lab == null) { ctx.lab = new HashMap(); } ctx.lab.target_id = m.target_id; ctx.lab.rebuild_generation = m.rebuild_generation;

set.description: Integration pipelines normally set this; never replaces an existing value and never touches @timestamp.
